$description: Levves colors, sampled from the Urban Flora wallpaper by depth plane: teal-black planes, a glowing fog, amber lit windows. Amber is the one accent.

bg-deep.$description: Nearest, darkest plane: the desktop, fields, dimming behind dialogs

bg.$description: The top bar, a window's content area, lists, the terminal

raised.$description: Title bars, keys, the selected row

border.$description: 1px hairlines inside a surface: between a window's areas, under a list header

text-faint.$description: Disabled text and decoration only: 3.6:1 on bg, too low for reading

text-soft.$description: Secondary text that still reads as content

fog.$description: The far fog: focus, the current tab or pane, meter fills, the light in shell panes, info

fog-deep.$description: Fog in shadow: an inactive meter fill, the unlit part of a scale

glow.$description: The brightest fog, for the rare highlight that must read as light

accent.$description: A lit window: the primary key. One per view

accent-edge.$description: Deprecated (Survey's amber key edge); flat now

critical.$description: Errors, late, usage at 85% and above

warning.$description: Warnings, due soon, usage at 70% and above

title-bar-inactive.$description: Title plane of every other window

edge.$description: The weak border on anything that floats (windows, popups, notifications, docked panels' free side): fog at opacity.outline over surface

well.$description: A window's content area, lists, readouts

well-pressed.$description: A key held down, the current tab

key-depth.$description: Deprecated (Survey's key bottom edge); flat now

field-edge.$description: A field's weak outline at rest: fog at opacity.field-outline over bg-deep. Focused, the outline is fog

dither-a.$description: Deprecated (Survey's dither): flat strip color for group headers until the pieces drop it

dither-b.$description: Deprecated; equal to dither-a, so the dither draws flat

terminal.$description: ANSI colors not covered above; red, green, yellow, blue and white reuse critical, success, warning, info and text

decorative.$description: From the wallpaper, for illustration only, never for meaning or text

selection.$description: Fog behind the selected row (with a 2px fog line at its left)

hover.$description: text over a hovered row or key

tag-fill.$description: A status tag's plane, in its status color

tag-edge.$description: Deprecated: tags have no outline now

outline.$description: Fog, the weak border on floating surfaces (the edge color)

field-outline.$description: Fog, a field's outline at rest

pane.$description: Frosted shell panes: popups, notifications, menus, the launcher

bar.$description: The frosted top bar: lighter than panes, it holds only a line of text

lamp.$description: Fog at the center of a frosted pane's lamp light, pooled at its top-right

key-glow.$description: Amber, the primary key's glow: the only glow in a view

edge-light.$description: Deprecated (Survey's engraved edge); zero, so it no longer draws

edge-shade.$description: Deprecated (Survey's engraved edge); zero, so it no longer draws

etch.$description: Deprecated (Survey's etched group box); zero, so it no longer draws
